summary: Add best-effort step (after tag verification in tag-release-merge job) to create the GitHub Release object using the reused create_github_release helper from #592. Happy-path automation for the Releases UI tab / latest badge / notes on normal Release PRs. Non-blocking (tag step remains authoritative). Same assets convention and notes rendering (DRY).
migration_impact: Downstream PLATE repos will now have the GitHub Release object (UI, latest, rich notes from release.json) automatically created as part of the tag job for Release PRs (best-effort). The explicit `gh plate release finalize` path remains available for repair/manual use or older flows. The helper and convention are shared with the finalize path from #592.
migration_guidance: If you have a customized release.yml, port the new step (modeled on the validate step; uses PYTHONPATH + the plate_core.release helper).
No changes needed to .plate config or extension checks for this.
The fragment ensures this is documented in the next release notes.
Test locally with a dry Release PR merge if possible.
agent_notes: Reuses create_github_release + _render_release_notes + assets logic exactly (DRY). Best-effort wrapper (set +e + try/except) per #593 refinement decisions under #591. Idempotent via helper. See full refined ACs and impl notes in #593 body. Complements #592 (finalize explicit path).
